# Bundled geometry library attributions

The bundled `polygon-clipping.js` is copied from easyeda/eext-auto-copper-shape commit 98317b6b5941977a3ae90948a05295f9d8b1169f. It includes Clipper 6.4.2.2 / clipper-lib 6.4.2, polygon-clipping and splaytree v3.1.2, as well as retained Microsoft Apache-2.0 helper attribution in its trailing license comments.

- polygon-clipping MIT text: https://github.com/mfogel/polygon-clipping/blob/v0.15.7/LICENSE.md
- Splaytree author and MIT designation: retained bundled header, https://github.com/w8r/splay-tree; accompanying full MIT text retains the named author.
- Clipper attribution: https://github.com/junmer/clipper-lib/blob/master/clipper.js (blob 7e9453dec06ad1c318b924b1cccca426834dfc79); Boost text from https://api.github.com/licenses/bsl-1.0
- JSBN license: http://www-cs-students.stanford.edu/~tjw/jsbn/LICENSE (retrieved 2026-10-09).

No dependency installation or library upgrade was performed. The upstream bundled program and its retained notices are the executable source; the linked license copies supplement those notices.
